plans.note: Sec 21.1 caps at one month of Fees 'without exception', which conflicts with the Excluded Claims regime in 21.3 and is far below our floor; raise cap and confirm carve-outs survive.
Section 20 contains only a broad Customer-side indemnity (20.1); Vendor IP/misconduct indemnity and the Section 20.5 remedies cross-referenced in 9.3 appear missing and must be added.
Sec 12.4 imposes a 24-month post-term non-compete on Customer and contradicts 12.3; strike it.
Sec 2.2 (first instance) makes Vendor sole and exclusive analytics provider; delete and rely on 12.3's no-exclusivity acknowledgement.
No MFN obligation on Customer found; 12.3 already disclaims any most-favoured-customer commitment. Confirm pricing sections contain no hidden MFN.
No non-solicit binding Customer; 12.3 preserves hiring from general recruitment. Verify no no-hire clause elsewhere in Section 12.
Sec 9.4 gives us convenience termination with refunds and bars Vendor's reciprocal right; check consistency with the take-or-pay in 2.1.
Sec 8.2 gives a 30-day opt-out with reminder mechanics and 8.3 caps uplift at lesser of CPI/3%; largely compliant, verify no prepaid-period increase.
New York law and New York County courts with no arbitration — within policy; confirm the escalation step in 28.3 does not bar urgent relief.
Sec 24.1/24.4 permit our affiliate and successor assignments and bar Vendor termination on our change of control; check 24.3 does not undercut 24.1.
Ownership of Customer Data and Deliverables sits with us; confirm the Deliverable and Vendor Technology definitions do not shrink what we own and that 15.1 blocks model training.
Sec 13.1 is Customer-only and revocable at Vendor's sole discretion — must extend to Affiliates/contractors and be non-revocable, aligning with 13.2 and 13.3.
Sec 22.1-22.3 already limit frequency, notice, off-site conduct and cost allocation; confirm Section 23 records duties do not create a wider audit right.
No liquidated damages or penalty payable by us located; nearest risks are the take-or-pay in 2.1 and interest on disputed amounts in 7.3.
Sec 19.2's 15-day Deliverable warranty with no remedy afterwards is too short; extend duration and keep the 19.4 repair/refund remedy non-exclusive.
Insurance present with cyber, E&O and GL limits; check limits against playbook minimums and that 18.2 preserves non-limitation of liability.
Sec 2.1 imposes a USD 2,000,000/year take-or-pay with no reduction or termination rights, conflicting with 9.4 and 12.3; delete or add exit/carry-forward.
Sec 11.1 requires immediate cessation of assistance and deletion, contradicting 11.2/11.3; replace with a defined transition-assistance period and data return.
